== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Scripts are patterns or shapes used to guide and manipulate [[madra]]. They function as drawings that can be etched into various materials, ranging from loose soil and wood to metal, stone, and bedrock. While they are less complex than [[binding|bindings]]—which are described as three-dimensional like statues—scripts serve to activate, control, or modify the effects of other objects and powers. They can be used to create protective wards, power flying weapons, facilitate vision, or manage the functions of complex machinery like cloudships. Scripts can interact with different types of aura and [[madra]], though their efficiency varies depending on the material they are inscribed upon and the specific aspects of energy they process. They can be used to power constructs, which are essentially puppets driven by a central [[binding]] but refined by additional scripts. Depending on their scale and power source, scripts can range from small, delicate markings to massive, miles-long networks etched into the earth. However, scripts are subject to physical limitations; if a [[Script|script]] is too powerful for its medium, it can cause the material to crack, deform, or break.}}
